id: \bI want to be Tucker's understudy. He is so strong.
en: \bI want to be Tucker's understudy. He is so strong.
it: \bVoglio diventare l'allievo di Tucker. È fortissimo.

id: \rTucker does Double Battles. It's a unique type of battle.
en: \rTucker does Double Battles. It's a unique type of battle.
it: \rTucker fa Lotte in Doppio. È un tipo di lotta davvero particolare.

id: \bThrough here you battle Tucker. Are you ready?
en: \bThrough here you battle Tucker. Are you ready?
it: \bDa qui si va a lottare contro Tucker. Sei pronto?

id: \rNurse Joy: You should take a break.
en: \rNurse Joy: You should take a break.

id: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great. Take care now!
en: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great.  Take care now!
it: \rOh, bene! Tu e i tuoi Pokémon avete un ottimo aspetto. Abbi cura di te!

id: \rFirst, you should restore your Pokémon to full health.
en: \rFirst, you should restore your Pokémon to full health.
it: \rPer prima cosa, dovresti rimettere in forze i tuoi Pokémon.

id: \bI love this place. You get to watch every battle.
en: \bI love this place. You get to watch every battle.
it: \bAdoro questo posto. Puoi guardare tutte le lotte.
